g.text: fix(cli): write redirected output as UTF-8 so EvoSci does not crash on Windows
fix: hold the server start lock in EvoSci deploy and the WebUI launcher
Don't treat directories such as archive.zip_ as zip files
fix(fs): don't remove stale compressed files of a custom FS.FS from disk
Log each failed server awareness send with its traceback
